APPENDIX 45  Nutritional Facts on Vitamin D
Mushrooms are the only plant food known to contain 
vitamin D, and the amount varies widely depending on the type 
of mushroom and amount of sunlight exposure during growth. 
Commercially raised mushrooms are now being grown with 
controlled UVB exposure so that they synthesize and thus con-
tain much more vitamin D than if grown in the wild.
